text:
kevin: Trying to wire the shared embed helper into the sample-app reranker. CI failing with a shape mismatch.

mira: Short snippet and error?

kevin: Minimal repro: curl to /v1/embeddings in node sample -> response body shows `vector` key with 768 floats. Python sample returns `embedding` with 1536 floats. Reranker stack expects (batch,1536) -> AssertionError.

joel: That sounds like two problems: SDK default alias drift (compact vs full) and response field-name divergence. Older node SDKs historically returned `vector`.

ci-bot: CI: samples/rerank-e2e #999 failed  rerank/stacker.py: expected (4,1536) got (4,768). Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/999 (sanitized).

mira: Can you paste sanitized response bodies (headers+body) and which auth used?

kevin: Node response (sanitized): {"data":[{"id":"u1","vector":[/* 768 floats */]}]}
Python response (sanitized): {"data":[{"id":"u1","embedding":[/* 1536 floats */]}]}
Auth: ephemeral token refresh path in the sample runner.

joel: Another wrinkle we've hit: token-refresh retries sometimes replay without the original idempotency header. If the aggregator uses arrival order, a faster retry with a different field name can overwrite earlier entries.

mira: Short-term mitigation for samples: add an adapter that normalizes response shapes and keys: prefer `embedding`, fallback `vector`, then `vec`. Convert to a canonical `embedding` and pad_or_trim to the expected dim for the chosen alias; raise a clear error if mismatch beyond small tolerance.

joel: Long-term: 1) enforce canonical response key server-side (`embedding`), 2) add SDK parity CI that enumerates embed aliases across SDKs and fails on dim/key drift, 3) ensure retries preserve idempotency-key and original headers.

ops-bot: Created infra ticket infra#402: preserve idempotency headers on token-refresh retries.

kevin: I'll land a tiny normalize shim in sample-apps to unblock demos and file a repro with sanitized logs. PR: https://github.com/redwood/sample-apps/pull/1400 (WIP).

mira: I'll own the parity CI job in samples CI and add an auto-issue creator when diffs are found.

joel: I'll pick up the idempotency header fix and a small note in onboarding docs: add `assert len(embedding) == EXPECTED_DIM` check so users get a friendly error.

kevin: Thanks 44D. Patch in samples will pad_or_trim for now and surface a helpful error message pointing to the SDK parity guide.
